descriptions.text: Twice in one week. Value DeFi is a trainwreck. Six months ago they lost $7M. Three days ago they lost $10M. Now they’ve lost another $11M. What went so wrong with Value DeFi?

DeFi protocol ValueDeFi is suspected of being hacked again after being hacked on the 5th. ValueDeFi reminds users in the community, "All non-50/50 transaction pools of the project have been used. Please stop purchasing gvVALUE and vBSWAP until the project team provides a solution." It was subsequently confirmed that more than 3,000 ETH (approximately 10 million U.S. dollars) were lost.

On May 7, 2021, ValueDefi's vSwap AMM on BNB Chain was exploited through a critical arithmetic flaw in the weighted constant-product invariant calculation for non 50/50 pools. The incident allowed an attacker to drain approximately $11 million across nine liquidity pools by crafting swaps that intentionally violated the invariant's assumptions. Incorrect use of a power() exponentiation routine in the invariant enforcement logic for vSwap pools with non-50/50 asset weights.
